summary: Temporary danger area EGD290C near Holbeach, from ground level to 2,300 ft above sea level, for uncrewed aircraft.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD290C INSTALLED WI AREA BOUNDED BY

2.3 NM CENTRED ON 525152.67N 0001001.83E - 525322.96N
